info.name: StartupGo LightRAG search
info.description:
Tests for POST /api/startups/search (LightRAG over the StartupGo database and the agent's entries).

Run: start the Backend (port 8000), then run the whole collection in order (Collection Runner, or `npx newman run lightrag_search.postman_collection.json`). baseUrl can point at the Vite proxy (http://127.0.0.1:5173) instead.

Folders 1-3 need no keys. Folders 4-5 need NVIDIA keys (CHAT_API_KEY, EMBEDDING_API_KEY) in Modules/Search/.env and are skipped otherwise; restart the Backend after adding them. Each LightRAG search takes about 80 s on NVIDIA's free tier (maxSearchMs, default 120000, is the response-time limit).

Expected results assume the committed Modules/Search/rag_storage (the 8 seed startups in DB/startupgo.db).
